mechanism: Methimazole reduces thyroid hormone levels, which decreases digoxin metabolism and increases serum digoxin concentrations, elevating toxicity risk; additionally, treatment of hyperthyroidism itself reduces digoxin requirements as metabolic rate normalizes.
action: Monitor serum digoxin levels closely and reduce digoxin dose by 30-50% when initiating methimazole; adjust dosing based on therapeutic digoxin concentrations (0.5-2.0 ng/mL) and clinical response.
